sections.title: Scope of Services
sections.text:
Status: available

North Miami Beach Optical is an optical-only office. It handles routine eye exams, glasses, contact lenses, prescriptions, frames, lenses, lens upgrades, adjustments, repairs, and payments.

The office accepts outside prescriptions and can schedule an eye exam with one of its professional optometrists. Patients can be seen as young as 7 years old.

Medical eye care, ophthalmology visits, surgery questions, urgent symptoms, and eye-problem care are not offered through this office.

sections.title: Optical and Glasses
sections.text:
Status: available

North Miami Beach Optical stocks many major frame brands, including Gucci, Montblanc, YSL, Ray-Ban, Emporio Armani, and Cartier.

The office offers all types of lenses, including lens upgrades and treatments.

Eyeglass prescriptions are valid for up to 2 years, but a yearly eye exam is recommended to make sure the prescription is current and the patient has the right lenses to improve their vision.

If a patient wants glasses and already has a prescription, they can bring the prescription from their optometrist and choose from the office's frame selection. Patients needing a prescription can obtain one through an optometrist appointment.

Glasses are usually ready in less than 10 business days.

Glasses pickup policy: a readiness text confirms glasses are ready for pickup; patients wait for that text before coming in. This policy does not establish an individual order's readiness.

sections.title: Contact Lenses
sections.text:
Status: available

Contact lens prescriptions are valid for up to 1 year.

If a patient wants contact lenses and already has a prescription, they can bring the prescription from their optometrist. Patients needing a prescription can obtain one through an optometrist appointment.

If the patient's contact lens prescription is on file, the office can take a contact lens order over the phone with payment.

sections.title: Repairs and Warranty
sections.text:
Status: available

Frames include free adjustments and a two- or three-year warranty.

Broken glasses and warranty questions require an in-person inspection of the frame or lenses.

sections.title: Insurance and Referrals
